name: apple-reminders-mcp
description: Read and manage macOS Reminders through EventKit, without ever rewriting what is already done
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift that gives Claude access to the Reminders app on this Mac.

There is no network, no account and no API key. iCloud is only the sync engine that fills the local reminder store. The gate is macOS privacy consent, and the grant appears under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Reminders.

A completed reminder is never modified or deleted. Ticking something off is the record that it was done, and this server refuses to rewrite that record even when asked — with one deliberate exception: it can always reopen a reminder, which is how a mistaken tick is undone. Once reopened it is an ordinary reminder again and can be edited or removed.

Searches look at open reminders unless asked otherwise, so "what do I need to do" does not come back full of things already finished.

A reminder given a due time also gets an alarm, because EventKit creates none by itself and a reminder that never notifies is not much of a reminder.

Lists can be created, renamed, recoloured and deleted — but a list that still holds reminders is never deleted, because removing a list takes its whole contents with it. Empty it first, or use Reminders.app.

Sections inside a list cannot be touched at all: they exist only inside Reminders.app and appear nowhere in EventKit, so no app other than Apple's own can read or create one.

EventKit cannot create repeating reminders; that must be done in Reminders.app.

Plug and play: there is nothing to configure. Every list is reachable, and the only control over what this server may do is each tool's own allow/ask/prohibit switch below.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

tools.name: reminders_status
tools.description: Report whether Reminders access is granted, and how to grant it. Reads no reminders.

tools.name: reminder_lists
tools.description: List the reminder lists, their accounts, and which accept writes

tools.name: reminders_search
tools.description: Find reminders by text, list, completion state and due date

tools.name: reminder_get
tools.description: Read one reminder in full, including whether it can still be edited

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Add a reminder. Cannot create a repeating one.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Change a reminder. Refuses reminders already completed.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Tick a reminder off, or reopen one that was ticked off by mistake

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Permanently delete a reminder. Requires explicit confirmation; refuses completed ones.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create an empty reminder list. Cannot create a section inside a list.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Rename a reminder list or change its colour

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Permanently delete a list. Requires explicit confirmation; refuses any list that still holds reminders.
